abilities.desc:
Strike one visible hostile within three tiles with a bodily chain. A successful physical hit deals 1d(5 + XL/3) damage before armour and may tether an eligible body, even if armour absorbs all the damage. The original distance becomes the chain's maximum length; the foe can move within it and still attack or cast. Lash lasts four, six or eight standard turns at XL1, XL7 or XL13. One chain can be maintained at a time. A miss or ended hold begins five turns of recovery.

Living chains ready.
Range: 3

This ability costs: nothing.
abilities.name: Chain Lash

abilities.desc:
Release your one living chain instantly and begin the same five-turn recovery as any other ending. Walking beyond a mobile tether's reach releases it automatically. Releasing never resets or shortens recovery.

Living chains ready.
Range: N/A

This ability costs: nothing.
This ability is instantaneous.
You can use this ability even if confused.
abilities.name: Release Chain

abilities.desc:
At an available god's own altar, permanently steal its single offered benefit and accept its wrath. Choose at most three distinct gods. The first theft supplies forty Defiance once; later thefts never refill it. Duplicate and ecumenical altars grant nothing. Profanation does not consume the altar or prevent an ally from worshipping there.

Defiance 0/100; Elder Rites 0/3.
Range: N/A

This ability costs: nothing.
abilities.name: Profane Altar

abilities.blocked_reason: Profane your first altar before undertaking an Elder Rite.
abilities.desc:
At XL9, XL15 and XL21, complete one short two-wave encounter to strengthen all your stolen benefits. Begin on safe open ground. The second wave arrives after four standard turns without waiting for the first wave to die. Trial actors grant no rewards. Killing or permanently banishing every trial actor wins; pacification, conversion and dismissal do not. Leaving the floor abandons the attempt, preserving completed rites. Only one party rite can be active on a floor.

Defiance 0/100; Elder Rites 0/3.
Range: N/A

This ability costs: nothing.
abilities.name: Invoke Elder Rites
